text:
Leah Morgan: Heads up We got a wave of 'renewal_touch' actions that hit customers with renewals in <14 days. Seeing 420 outbound nudges. Not good.
Priya Desai: Wait what Wasn't the renewal gate set to 30d?
Marcus Chen: Yep. Logs show an override param: `force_mode=true` on run id run_42f.
Ops Bot: playbook-exec run_42f finished  420 actions  390 nudges  30 skipped /alert
Leah Morgan: Who flipped force_mode? Is this an ad-hoc run or a deploy side-effect?
Rowan Li: I pulled the run metadata: `trigger=manual`, `initiator=automation-service`, `env=prod`. Looks like the daily reconciler called the playbook with a mistaken flag.
Priya Desai: Immediate mitigation: 1) pause playbook trigger 2) add renewal-age gate `renewal_days >= 30` 3) tag touched rows `automation:mishit` and surface to CS dashboard
Marcus Chen: Also recommend soft-revoke outreach for impacted accounts and add a counter metric `automation.renewal_mishit_count`.
Leah Morgan: I'll craft the customer note. Marcus, can you run a rollback batch to cancel queued emails? Command: `scripts/cancel_outbound --run run_42f --limit 1000`
Marcus Chen: Running now. ETA ~12m.
Ops Bot: scheduler paused by Marcus Chen at 1749907832
Rowan Li: I'll add a config validation rule in the playbook CI: reject `force_mode=true` unless `ci_override=true` and signoff present.
Priya Desai: After rollback, let's run a 200-account audit sample to check healthscore deltas and any churn risk signals.
Leah Morgan: Owners: @Priya (customer comms), @Marcus (rollback & metrics), @Rowan (CI guard). Tag me on updates.
Marcus Chen: Cancel job completed. 412 items cancelled, 8 already sent. Patch incoming for gate and metric.
Leah Morgan: Thanks all. We'll monitor renewal cohort dashboards and follow up in morning sync. :white_check_mark:
